user.title: AVS cloud account
user.description: Enter the credentials used in Mio Antifurto. Device ID is optional: reuse the probe ID to avoid registering another device.

data_description.device_id: 16 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Leave empty to generate a stable ID.

plant.title: Installation and PIN
plant.description: Sign in with the central panel PIN. Commands also require this PIN in Home Assistant. Signing in can register a device in the AVS account.

reauth_confirm.title: Update AVS credentials
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the account credentials and central panel PIN for the configured installation.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication refused. Check account credentials and PIN in the AVS app.
error.invalid_pin: Enter a numeric PIN. Leading zeros are preserved.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot read the installation. Check connectivity and try again later.
error.account_error: AVS account needs attention: check subscription, device limit or consent in the official app.

abort.plant_not_found: This account does not contain the configured installation.

init.title: Updates and mode mapping
init.description: Mapping determines both displayed states and commands sent. Assign a different HA state to each AVS mode and check mode names in the official app. Commands retain zone checks and never force arming.

error.duplicate_modes: Assign a different HA state to each AVS mode.

invalid_code.message: Enter the central panel PIN configured in the integration, preserving leading zeros.

ambiguous_mode.message: Mode is missing or ambiguous. Configure a unique mapping in the integration options.

mode_not_allowed.message: This mode is not permitted for this sector or its state is unavailable.

command_rejected.message: The panel refused the command or the mode is not permitted. Check open zones, faults and permissions in the official app. Arming was not forced.

command_failed.message: Command delivery is unconfirmed. Check the state in the official app before retrying. The command was not automatically retried.

command_unconfirmed.message: Command accepted, but reading the state failed. Check the state in the official app before retrying.
